_meta.analysis_window: Explicit past-24-hour review for every configured tracker and required sector, with 7/14/30-day context for low-frequency and emerging lanes
_meta.source_limitation: All 20 required Tavily searches and both Tavily extraction attempts returned HTTP 432. Fallback coverage completed through Google News RSS (18 core lanes plus 49 targeted lanes), Bing News RSS date audits, browser redirects to direct publisher URLs, direct UN/NATO/EIA pages and feeds, terminal HTTP, Jina Reader as an access layer, OilPriceAPI and public Gamma exact-slug reads. Direct IAEA and OPEC pages returned HTTP 403/Cloudflare; configured OCHA and UN Sudan feed paths returned HTTP 404. The modern NATO press-release path returned HTTP 404, while the official latest-news page and legacy media-advisory endpoint remained reachable. False-recency pages from 2013 and March 2026 were inspected and excluded. Single-source or repeated official-claim chains were not promoted.
morning_deep_scan_movers: India rose 11% to 15% after two outlets corroborated repeated direct LoC exchanges over three days; no configured signal was activated because no verified force concentration was established
The pipeline-weighted coupled score reached 74.516 and crossed the rounding threshold, moving the published global score from 74% to 75% / imminent
Russia-Ukraine remains 99%; Reuters raised the Kyiv toll to one killed and nine injured, with two additional deaths reported in Odesa
Iran conventional remains capped at 100%; AP added a Sirik-area strike and a separate Irbil drone attack wounded eight
Israel-Lebanon remains 94% coupled as Aoun’s Washington peace push offsets fresh attack evidence

auto_detection.decision: No untracked crisis met the configured min_mentions=3 and min_sources=2 gate with one distinct fresh independently corroborated operational cluster.
watchlist: Somalia: multiple outlets repeated one Somali Defence Ministry claim of 25 al-Shabaab deaths; casualty and operational details remained independently unverified, so this was treated as one claim chain.

Thailand-Cambodia: the only fresh item was Xi Jinping offering help to settle the dispute, a de-escalatory diplomatic development rather than a new operational cluster.

Syria and Iraq results were Iran-war spillover or query pollution; Ethiopia, South China Sea, Libya, Mozambique, Kosovo-Serbia, Guyana-Venezuela and Armenia-Azerbaijan lacked a distinct fresh qualifying cluster.
